about: E1 golden values (design §3.7), recorded on the v1 engine and renderer at the learn-v2 base, before any learn code changed. Hashes and counts only, no entity ID. Recipe: learn/tests/golden.py. page_sha256 is golden.page_sha() of site/dist/learn/hijrah-step-by-step/index.html built by site/build.py then learn/build_learn.py on build/graph.ttl: every href and id attribute value blanked, whitespace runs collapsed, sha256 of the UTF-8 text. The gate is golden.content_facts() of the Hijrah journey on that graph (ordered step pids, each step's entity fields, every claim about a step or behind a reason, as sorted rows). While the gate matches, the v2 Study page with nav.journey-depths and the s-* anchor spans removed must give page_sha256; once it differs the golden test skips with 're-verify E1'. Stage C adds the Hijrah content_sha (§9) here once it exists, computed on the graph whose gate values match.
